title: plugin-list: an ungrouped list view does not fetch the declared nameField, so the bulk confirm step shows Record #ID (follow-up to #13107)
body:
Part of #13107. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from the objectui#13107 dev report (PR #13112, open question 1, ruled A: a separate card).

## Problem

objectui#13107 makes the grid (`plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid` `getSelectFields`) harvest the declared `nameField` into its `$select`, and makes the bulk confirm step fall to the resolver's `Record #ID` floor instead of a derived field. That covers every list whose rows the grid fetches, including server-grouped lists. That is the case measured on HotCRM's All Contacts, which groups by account.

An **ungrouped** list view fetches through `plugin-list` `ListView`. Its `$select` harvest (`addSpeculative`) has arms for view bindings, grouping, `rowColor`, `settledWhen` and `referenceVia`, but none for `nameField` (`grep nameField` in `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` returns 0 hits on `df943a2a1a`). So on such a list, when the declared `nameField` is not a column, the bulk confirm step now lists `Record #ID` instead of the record's name. That is no longer a wrong name, but it is still not the name.

## Target

- `ListView`'s harvest adds `declaredNameField(objectDef)` beside the `rowColor` and `referenceVia` arms, through the same projection gates. It is fetched, not drawn.
- Pin: an ungrouped list whose `nameField` is not a column lists the names in the confirm step, and its `$select` carries the field. An object with no `nameField` is unchanged.

Surface: `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, tests beside it, and one `@object-ui/plugin-list` `patch` changeset.
